messages:
maya: kicking off staged rollout v5.0.0 -> canary 6% (us-central). change window 09:00-11:00 CT. release notes: https://redwood/release/v5.0.0 :tada:

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT r-4129 initiated. targets: canary=6% us-central. monitors: p95_latency, mem_usage, semantic-regression. log stream: /rollouts/r-4129. :robot_face:

chris: smoke checks green. starting lightweight A/B on 3 canary nodes for top-200 queries.

perf-bot: alert: mem_usage on canary cohort trending up: avg=68% -> 84% over 12m. not yet OOM but atypical slope. tagging for ops review.

maya: noticing small uptick in p95 for long-chat flows too (120ms -> 190ms). correlates with memory trend.

ops_lead: pause ramp and pin until we understand. pin if necessary. please keep canary traffic at 6% and do not increase.

deploy-bot: command: `deploy-bot pin r-4129 --reason "mem-trend+p95-uptick"` -> done. state=paused_at_6pct. audit: ops_lead at 4129998925.

infra: infra note: one canary nodepool (cpool-3) showing heavier pagecache usage; collecting vmstat and dmesg.

chris: logs snippet for context:
```
[09:12:01] model-worker cpool-3 node-7 mem=86% rss=7.8GB req=aa1
[09:12:02] proxy node-7 conn_reset req=aa1 status=502
[09:12:03] reranker: small score dip avg=0.78 baseline=0.82
```

maya: QA ran targeted eval on safety+semantics (ev-4129-1). preliminary: pass_rate=93% baseline=95% delta=-2pp (under threshold) but perf regression present. full eval queued.

perf-bot: queued ev-4130 (top-200 + long-chat). ETA ~9m.

ops_lead: decision matrix: rollback if mem_usage continues to rise or if ev-4130 shows semantic delta >=3pp or 5xx >1% sustained 10m. Otherwise hold and triage infra. rollback command ready: `deploy-bot rollback r-4129 --to v4.9.8 --notify cs-team`.

chris: I can reproduce mem slope locally when KV cache size increases with long-context requests. suspect cache sizing and GC behavior.

infra: we have a low-risk kernel tunable (vm.swappiness) we can test on a single canary node, but that requires recycle and will temporarily reduce capacity. prefer evaluation then decide.

maya: prefer not to risk partial infra tweak while unknown quality impact. let's wait for eval.

eval-bot: ev-4130 complete. results: top-200 pass_rate=92% baseline=95% delta=-3pp (threshold hit). long-chat perf p95 delta +70ms. report: https://redwood/evals/ev-4130 flagged per policy.

chris: delta crosses our semantic threshold on the top-queries. combined with memory trend, I recommend rollback to v4.9.8.

ops_lead: any objections to rollback? speak now or we'll execute.

infra: no objection. will open remediation ticket to reproduce mem growth and test vm.swappiness in staging (TKT-INF-513).

maya: rolling back. CS on standby. draft message: "We paused v5.0.0 canary after a quality/perf regression linked to memory growth; reverting to v4.9.8 while we investigate."

deploy-bot: executing: `deploy-bot rollback r-4129 --to v4.9.8 --notify "cs-team@redwood" --reason "mem-growth + semantic regression"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic reverted to v4.9.8. state=rolled_back. audit: rollback by maya at 4129999048.

perf-bot: post-rollback checks: mem_usage returned to baseline 70% within 3m; p95_latency back to 125ms.

ops_lead: postmortem actions: collect failing queries from ev-4130, reproduce with KV cache toggles in staging, test vm.swappiness and GC tuning, and run full eval before reattempt. schedule triage at 13:00 CT.

cs-team: customer note queued and will be sent immediately.

maya: thanks all. closing this rollout thread. will re-open when patch + staging evals pass. :white_check_mark:
